results.title: CRAN Task View: Analysis of Spatial Data
results.content: ## CRAN Task View: Analysis of Spatial Data. | **Contributions:** | Suggestions and improvements for this task view are very welcome and can be made through issues or pull requests on GitHub or via e-mail to the maintainer address. | **Installation:** | The packages from this task view can be installed automatically using the ctv package. Base R includes many functions that can be used for reading, visualising, and analysing spatial data. The focus in this view is on “geographical” spatial data, where observations can be identified with geographical locations, and where additional information about these locations may be retrieved if the location is recorded with care. Information about source installs of packages using software external to R may be found at the end of this page. The contributed packages address two broad areas: moving spatial data into and out of R including coordinate transformation, and analysing spatial data in R.
